How to Use Filters in This Google Sheet
Click On Row 8; Click On Create Filter View In The Data Menu Up Top

Locate the Dropdown Button:

You'll see a small dropdown button next to the column name at the top of each column (e.g., Company Category, Job Title).
Click the button to open filter options.
You can use the "Filter by values" options to refine your search.
You can select "Clear", then search for and select all options you'd like to see within any column

Examples:
Filter Location Type for "remote" to see remote-only jobs.
Filter Company Category to show only "Gaming Company" listings.
Filter Location to show only "London" listings.
